Owned regression for a public static method whose seed and result share a closed Collection<String> bound and a checked exception contract. All source/SDK definitions compile with original signatures, Code roles and Exceptions. Four frozen call routes cover virtual delegation, callbacks, null/immutable inputs, partial writes, opaque replacement results, checked/error identity and delayed caller casts. Each profile runs 96 fresh JVM cases twice, eight wrong programs and six Code-preserving Signature controls. No application or third-party binary is included.
